notes: Ludum Dare 59 entry Signalien (https://ldjam.com/events/ludum-dare/59/signalien). Complete Unity 6000.3.9f1 project (Assets+ProjectSettings+Packages) with playable SampleScene, gameplay scripts (player, aliens, beam, terrain, UI), exported PNG sprites, and short SFX. MIT. Official Unity 6 packages only (2D, URP, Input System). Omitted 14 Git LFS-tracked author Aseprite working files (*.aseprite); playable exported PNG sprites are included. No bundled fonts, no FXAA, no Unity Standard Assets, no DOTween, no EmojiOne, no Asset Store packages, no LFS pointers, no DLL/EXE. ~6.1M src snapshot.
